summary: LifeStance Health Group filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing a September 9 Underwriting Agreement among the Company, Barclays Capital Inc., and selling stockholders for a 22.25 million-share secondary offering of LifeStance common stock. All shares were sold by selling stockholders, and LifeStance concurrently repurchased 2,000,000 shares from the underwriter at the same price paid to the sellers, with no underwriting compensation on those repurchased shares. No price per share, premium, expected close, or board recommendation was stated in the excerpt. Closing occurred September 11. The structural overhang from selling holders is offset by the company's buyback; watch for pricing detail and any remaining lock-ups.
